model.rawSql:
WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, station, sensor, name, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours' UNION ALL SELECT time, station, sensor, name, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours'),
minutes AS (SELECT station, sensor, date_bin(interval '1 minute', time) AS t, avg(humidity_pct) AS h
  FROM rooms GROUP BY station, sensor, date_bin(interval '1 minute', time)),
rises AS (SELECT station, sensor, t, h, min(h) OVER (PARTITION BY station, sensor ORDER BY t
  ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS before FROM minutes),
showers AS (SELECT station, sensor, min(t) AS started, first_value(before ORDER BY t) AS before
  FROM rises WHERE h - before >= 10 AND t >= now() - interval '90 minutes' AND t <= now() - interval '40 minutes'
  GROUP BY station, sensor),
latest AS (SELECT station, sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  last_value(humidity_pct ORDER BY time) AS h,
  min(humidity_pct) AS low FROM rooms GROUP BY station, sensor)
SELECT l.station, l.sensor, l.room, l.h AS value
FROM latest l JOIN showers s ON s.station = l.station AND s.sensor = l.sensor
WHERE l.low < 65

WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, station, sensor, name, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours' UNION ALL SELECT time, station, sensor, name, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours'),
minutes AS (SELECT station, sensor, date_bin(interval '1 minute', time) AS t, avg(humidity_pct) AS h
  FROM rooms GROUP BY station, sensor, date_bin(interval '1 minute', time)),
rises AS (SELECT station, sensor, t, h, min(h) OVER (PARTITION BY station, sensor ORDER BY t
  ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS before FROM minutes),
showers AS (SELECT station, sensor, min(t) AS started, first_value(before ORDER BY t) AS before
  FROM rises WHERE h - before >= 10 AND t >= now() - interval '90 minutes' AND t <= now() - interval '40 minutes'
  GROUP BY station, sensor),
latest AS (SELECT station, sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  last_value(humidity_pct ORDER BY time) AS h,
  min(humidity_pct) AS low FROM rooms GROUP BY station, sensor)
SELECT l.station, l.sensor, l.room, l.h - s.before AS value
FROM latest l JOIN showers s ON s.station = l.station AND s.sensor = l.sensor
WHERE l.low < 65

model.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT station, max(time) AS seen FROM station
  WHERE time >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY station)
SELECT d.station, d.sensor, last_value(d.name ORDER BY d.time) AS room,
  date_part('epoch', max(l.seen) - max(d.time))
    + last_value(d.unchanged_s ORDER BY d.time) AS value
FROM derived d JOIN latest l ON l.station = d.station
WHERE d.time >= now() - interval '7 days' AND d.unchanged_s IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.sensor IN ('indoor', 'outdoor') OR d.sensor LIKE 'ch%')
GROUP BY d.station, d.sensor

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.room }} has reported the same readings for {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }}: its battery or radio has probably failed.
annotations.headline: These sensors have reported the same readings for 6 hours or more: a battery or radio has probably failed.
annotations.description: A room or outdoor sensor whose readings have not changed, or not arrived, for 6 hours of the station's reports. A console repeats a lost sensor's last values, so unchanged readings are how a lost one shows; a still room at night can hold its readings for two or three hours, a lost sensor for good. Measured against the station's last report rather than the clock, so a station that stops uploading altogether does not flag every sensor; a sensor silent for more than 7 days drops out.
